create_PromptThinkerCoder: create a PromptThinkerCoder instance with a BarkourClient and SafeExecutor for LLM-based robot motion generation
run_process_thinker_response: run process_thinker_response to extract motion description from LLM output between start and end of description markers
run_process_coder_response: run process_coder_response to extract Python code block from LLM coder response
run_execute_code: run execute_code to safely execute generated robot control code and apply task parameters and cost weights
summarize_prompt_thinker_coder: summarize the prompt_thinker and prompt_coder templates used for quadruped robot motion description and code generation
